summary: Comprehensive testing of the new inquiry/booking process improvements. All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly: offer confirmation page with 2-step flow (review → confirm), admin offer dialog with amount input, inquiry form with progress bar and inline validation, /trucks page loading correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test inquiries created and cleaned up during pytest execution
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new offer confirmation features tested and working. The 2-step offer confirmation flow (GET for preview, POST for confirm) is fully functional. Admin offer dialog appears when clicking 'Offerte gesendet' status. Inquiry form has progress bar and inline validation.

offer_confirmation_api.details: GET /api/confirm-offer/{id}/{token} returns offer details without auto-confirming. POST with payment_method confirms. GET after POST shows already_confirmed=true with payment_method stored.

offer_confirmation_page.details: Shows event details (date, location, guests, trucks), offer amount (CHF), payment method selection (Rechnung/Barzahlung), confirm button. Already confirmed state shows confirmation date and payment method.

admin_offer_dialog.details: Dialog appears when clicking 'Offerte gesendet' status button. Has amount input field and send button. Shows event summary.

inquiry_form_progress_bar.details: Progress bar shows 0% when empty, increases as fields are filled (tested 50% with 4 fields filled).

inquiry_form_inline_validation.details: 'Pflichtfeld' validation message appears on blur for empty required fields.

trucks_page.details: /trucks page returns 200 and displays truck cards correctly
